title: Meade #12 - HOOK v3 (new words + ONE continuous geographic zoom; hook-a getty_hd_ref hook-1..3, hook-b penn_hd_ref hook-4), 0:00-1:23
note: hook-1: stamps from frame 0; arrows over the Mason-Dixon line on 'marches into Pennsylvania'; continuous dive (no cut, no flash) 6.4-8.2 s landing on 'Gettysburg'; 51,000 on its words. hook-b images = earlier snapshots (scene rebuilt for the new timing, content unchanged).

MARCHING INTO PENNSYLVANIA stamp; arrows to Chambersburg, Gettysburg, York
'to a small town': Gettysburg ring + label; the continuous zoom-whoosh DIVE starts (one camera for both maps)
DIVE ~10x: penn -> Gettysburg map cross-fade (feathered edges, no cut)
Arrives on 'Gettysburg': Gettysburg map wide, label lands, columns + flags in
Columns on the road spokes, guns firing

Fishhook: blue line glows on Cemetery Ridge, red wraps the outside; 72,000 ROBERT E. LEE on 'stop him'
3 JULY 3 PM, option 2: Pettigrew + Pickett step out on Seminary Ridge; 12,500 counter

Longstreet hits the left, impacts; ring 2 GETTYSBURG 2 JULY
